sources.title: QWEN2.5-32B-Translation | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: What is QWEN2.5-32B-Translation? QWEN2.5-32B-Translation is a specialized multilingual translation model built on the Qwen 2.5 32B architecture. It has been meticulously fine-tuned to handle translations across 16 different languages, achieving performance levels comparable to larger 72B models.

sources.title: GitHub - aibrainarchitect/Qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
